name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=render, descriptor=summon_aura_sprite_ring). No Ghidra address residue. Accurately reflects the purpose verified from body + caller: it is dispatch-table entry +1 (offset +0x04) of the 10-element summon-spell cinematic-phase handler table at 0x523B9, rendering the 8-directional summon-spell aura sprite ring around the caster across phases (state 3 init / 4 blit / 5 blit+advance).
purpose: Phase tick/renderer for the 8-directional summon-spell aura sprite ring drawn around the caster; one entry of the per-spell cinematic-phase fn-ptr dispatch table, called indirectly with the current phase/state code.
logic_summary: Prologue REP-MOVSD copies two 8-entry .rodata tables (x_off @ 0x52420, row_mul @ 0x52440) into the local frame. If caster is on the enemy team (runtime_char[caster].bTeam==0) every x_off[i] is shifted by +0x94 to mirror the ring to the enemy side. Per-slot phase counters live in the upper 8 slots [7..14] of the shared 15-slot int counter array (counter[i+7], base array @ 0x53F42, slot 7 = 0x53F5E). Dispatch on state_code: 3 (INIT) sets counter[i+7] = -2*i (staggering 8 slots 2 ticks apart) and returns 0x1F; 4 (BLIT N->S) blits, for each in-range slot (0<=counter<0xF), the unrotated frame=counter for slots 0..3 at slot i and the tail-set frame=counter+0xF for slots 4..7 at the 180-deg-paired slot j=(i+4)%8, returns 0; 5 (BLIT S->N + ADVANCE, mirror of 4) does the swapped pairing then advances every counter[i+7]++ (counter==9 -> done_flag=1 mid-cycle done signal; counter==5 -> play per-slot chime SFX via the summon SFX bank), returns done_flag; any other state_code returns 0. Each blit destination is row_mul[k]*row_stride + x_off[k] + 0x50 + origin_y (origin_y = destination work-buffer base).
signature: int __cdecl fd2_render_summon_aura_sprite_ring(int caster_unit_id, int sprite_handle, int origin_y, int row_stride, char state_code)

params.name: caster_unit_id
params.semantics: Index of the casting unit into data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr; only its .bTeam byte (+6, *0x50 stride) is read to choose the enemy-side +0x94 X shift.
params.reason: Descriptive, matches caller's caster_idx argument, no address residue.

params.name: sprite_handle
params.semantics: Sprite-sheet handle passed straight to fd2_blit_indexed_sprite as sheet_ptr (caller passes the team caster sprite handle).
params.reason: Accurate generic descriptor for the sprite-sheet handle; no address residue.

params.name: origin_y
params.semantics: Destination work-buffer base. Caller (fd2_play_spell_cast_sequence) passes the malloc(0x2A300) frame-scratch buffer pointer (ESI) or that pointer plus a per-call offset; this value is added into the fd2_blit_indexed_sprite dst_buf argument (row_mul[k]*row_stride + x_off[k] + 0x50 + origin_y). It is a linear destination buffer base, NOT a y coordinate.
params.reason: Current name 'origin_y' is misleading: disassembly + caller (push of ESI = the 0x2A300 work buffer, or ESI+offset, at e.g. 0x2AC16) show it is the destination work-buffer base added into the blit dst_buf arg, not a y-axis coordinate. Stage-2 rename to dst_buf_base.

params.name: row_stride
params.semantics: Destination row stride (caller passes 0x140 full-frame or 0x280 wide-composite); used both as the IMUL multiplier for row_mul[k] and as the fd2_blit_indexed_sprite dst_stride argument.
params.reason: Accurate; matches caller stride value and the dst_stride blit slot; no address residue.

params.name: state_code
params.semantics: Cinematic phase/state code (caller passes the per-call-site immediate; this function acts on 3=init, 4=blit N->S, 5=blit S->N+advance; other codes return 0).
params.reason: Accurate descriptor for the per-phase dispatch selector; no address residue.

returns.semantics: state 3 -> 0x1F (tick wait, 31 ticks before next phase); state 5 -> done_flag (1 once any slot counter reaches 9, else 0); state 4 and all other states -> 0. Caller uses the value as the per-phase frame/iteration count.

reads_globals: data_fd2_audio_summon_spell_sfx_bank_buf_ptr @ 0x5411F (SFX bank handle for the per-slot chime)
comment_original_issue: The original block was accurate on logic but described the fd2_blit_indexed_sprite call args imprecisely as 'the x argument' (composed value), 'row_stride passed as the y argument', and '-1 as mode'. Per the blit signature (sheet_ptr, sprite_idx, dst_buf, dst_stride, palette_op) the composed value is the dst_buf base, row_stride is dst_stride, and -1 is palette_op. It also did not flag that the 'origin_y' parameter is actually the destination work-buffer base (caller passes the 0x2A300 frame-scratch buffer), not a y coordinate.
notes: Function is invoked only indirectly via DATA xref from 0x523BD (table entry +1 of 10 at 0x523B9); no direct CALL callers, confirmed by get_function_callers. Dispatch-table layout verified by reading 0x523B9: entry[1] = 0x000262EF. Caller fd2_play_spell_cast_sequence pushes args (caster_idx, sprite_handle, work_buf, stride, phase_code) and ADD ESP,0x14 (5 cdecl args), result EAX used as phase frame count -- verified at call site 0x2AC0D-0x2AC25 (PUSH ESI = the 0x2A300 work buffer for arg3/origin_y). Frame counter index math (i+7) verified: array base 0x53F42 (int[15]), slot accesses at EBX*4+0x53F5E, 0x53F5E-0x53F42=0x1C=7 int32s. Tail-jumps to shared epilogue at 0x270F9 (Watcom shared 0x44+4-reg POP sequence) -- this is a codegen detail, no logic concern. No logic/equivalence issues found; src matches decompiled body exactly. Only param-name rename (origin_y -> dst_buf_base) recorded for Stage 2; no symbol renamed, no signature/declaration changed.
